question: For performed procedures whose treatment record and linked hospital stay refer to the same patient, show the patient name, procedure code and treatment date, performing and primary-care doctors' names separately, admission and discharge times, and the stay's room number and type.

Trace each resident-linked customer event to its household and service object. Give the customer details, property address, occupancy-record details, and the service object's type and service description. Use the specific residence identified on the event, including its move-in date.

For each destroyed document's storage-history entry, give the document name, its type description and location code, and the reference calendar's day numbers for initial document storage, entry into that location, and actual destruction.
Find the student first and last names and grade points of all enrollments.
Which named students have course registrations included on transcripts? Give each student's first and last names, the course ID for each included registration, and the transcript's ID and date.

For every shipped order line, show its product code and item status, the shipment's tracking number and date, the ordering customer's name for that line, and the order-placement date referenced by the shipment header. Keep the line's originating order and the header's order as separate references.

For each course enrollment, give the student number, course title, letter grade, and instructor's first and last names. Also show every departmental appointment held by that instructor, with its appointment type and department name.

For each enrollment, show the student's first and last names, course code and the points corresponding to that enrollment's letter grade. Alongside it, list the names of departments in which the student has a recorded minor, rather than their major.

For each resident-linked customer event, give the event ID, the details of the occupancy identified by its resident, property and move-in date, the service object's type code and description, its recorded organization's details, and every dated location code recorded for that object.

I need the full register of physical draft copies, including copies with no circulation history. Give the document, draft and copy numbers and the names and role descriptions of employees recorded as having handled each copy; leave employee fields blank when there is no record.
